Subject: Supply partner kickoff: evidence intake and PO onramps

Hi Jenny —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the supplier setup with us. To get procurement and finance moving, can you please send the following items as soon as possible: 

- Certificate(s) of Insurance: Commercial General Liability (GL) with limits, E&O / Professional Liability endorsement, and Cyber/Privacy liability evidence.
- W-9 (filled and signed).
- Vendor billing contact, remit-to address, and bank details for ACH (or an indication that PO-only billing is required).
- Estimated timeline for first invoice and whether Solvex requires a PO number to begin work.

Two small notes from our side: 
- For GL we typically require Redwood Inference to be listed as Additional Insured and a waiver of subrogation for covered operations. If your carrier needs exact language, please let us know and I can paste the standard wording.
- For cyber, if you have a policy declaration or binder showing aggregate limits and retroactive date, that speeds our review.

If easier, you can upload documents directly to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/procurement/solvex-supplier-packet (see link in thread metadata).

Appreciate a quick ETA. We aim to generate a PO within 3 business days of receiving complete evidence and W-9.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Procurement Coordinator
Redwood Inference
